column1: # ZAP baseline scan gate config, used only by the dast-zap job's second
# Unlisted rule IDs keep zap-baseline.py's own default classification
# (WARN) and are visible in the full report but never fail the job (the
# gate pass runs with -I, which suppresses failure on WARN-only results).
# Only the rule IDs listed below as FAIL can fail the gate. This mirrors
# the rest of the pipeline's severity-filtering philosophy (Bandit
# medium+, Semgrep ERROR, Trivy CRITICAL/HIGH): block merges on
# real, actionable findings, not on informational/low-risk noise.
# Deliberately a conservative starter set: each ID below was verified
# individually against ZAP's own alert reference (zaproxy.org/docs/alerts/<id>)
# on 2026-08-21, rather than copied from an unverified list. Expand this
# file after reviewing the dast-zap job's first few real full-report runs
# (uploaded as the zap-report artifact) for other alert types this app
